name: Microsoft Graph API Guidelines Evaluation Rubric
description: Comprehensive style rules based on Microsoft Graph API Guidelines. Microsoft Graph provides a unified API endpoint for accessing Microsoft 365 services including users, groups, mail, calendar, files, and more. This profile includes Graph-specific patterns like OData conventions, navigation properties, actions, functions, and delta queries.

categories.name: URI Design
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API uses the standard Microsoft Graph endpoint (graph.microsoft.com).

categories.name: OData Conventions

options.label: Pass
criteria: Documentation mentions OData query parameter support
At least $select and $filter are supported
Query parameters follow OData naming conventions

options.label: Partial
criteria: Some OData parameters are supported but not all
Custom query parameters are used instead of standard OData

options.label: Fail
criteria: No query parameter support is documented
Non-standard parameter names are used

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API documents support for standard OData query parameters ($select, $filter, $orderby, $top, $expand).

categories.name: Navigation Properties
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if relationships between entities are expressed as navigation properties in the URL path.

categories.name: Actions and Functions
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if custom operations that modify state use POST method (OData actions).

categories.name: Delta Queries

options.label: Pass
criteria: Delta function is documented for major collections
Delta response includes @odata.deltaLink
Changed and deleted items are clearly indicated

options.label: Partial
criteria: Delta is supported but only for some collections
Delta response format differs slightly

options.label: Fail
criteria: No delta query support
Only full sync is available

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if key collections support delta queries for change tracking.

categories.name: Batch Requests
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API supports JSON batching via /$batch endpoint.

categories.name: Permissions
categories.description: Scopes and consent for Graph API

options.label: Pass
criteria: Required permissions are documented for each endpoint
Both delegated and application permissions are listed
Least-privilege permissions are recommended

options.label: Partial
criteria: Permissions are documented but not for all endpoints
Only one permission type is documented

options.label: Fail
criteria: No permission documentation
Permissions are unclear or missing

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if each endpoint documents required permissions/scopes for access.

categories.name: Throttling
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API documents 429 Too Many Requests response for throttling.

categories.name: Extensions
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API supports schema extensions for custom properties.

categories.name: Webhooks
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API supports webhook subscriptions for change notifications.

categories.name: Graph Naming
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if timestamp properties use the DateTime suffix convention.

categories.name: Type Definitions
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if entity types include an 'id' property for unique identification.
